step1_analysis.description: A phase interpolator circuit used to adjust the clock phase in a high-speed DRAM interface. It mixes multiple input clock phases using parallel differential pairs with diode-connected loads to generate a fine-adjusted output clock phase, minimizing repeater latency.

paper_reference.title: A 3.6-Gb/s Point-to-Point Heterogeneous-Voltage-Capable DRAM Interface for Capacity-Scalable Memory Subsystems

power_consumption.description: Average power dissipated by the phase interpolator circuit during active clock mixing.

sky130_expected.calculation: Tail currents are set by VBP and VBN. Assuming ~1mA per tail current source (W/L=5/0.5), total current is ~2mA. Power = 1.8V * 2mA = 3.6 mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The 80 mW reported in the paper is for the entire I/O block. A single phase interpolator sub-block will consume a fraction of this, typically a few milliwatts.

propagation_delay.description: Time delay from the input clock crossing 50% VDD to the output clock crossing 50% VDD.

sky130_expected.calculation: Delay is determined by the RC time constant at the output nodes. With diode-connected loads, resistance is ~1/gm. C_load is parasitic capacitance of the wide transistors.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Expected to be in the tens of picoseconds range, aligning with the 29.7 ps and 46.7 ps jitter/delay figures reported in the paper for 3.6 Gb/s operation.

output_voltage_swing.description: Peak-to-peak voltage swing at the output nodes (N0, N2).

sky130_expected.calculation: Outputs are clamped by diode-connected NMOS to GND and PMOS to VDD. Max voltage ~ VDD - |Vthp| (1.8 - 0.42 = 1.38V). Min voltage ~ Vthn (0.42V). Swing = 1.38 - 0.42 = 0.96V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Current Mode Logic (CML) style phase interpolators use low-swing signaling to achieve high speeds (3.6 Gb/s). The diode loads naturally limit the swing to roughly VDD - 2*Vth.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure the propagation delay, output voltage swing, and average power consumption of the phase interpolator when driven by 1 GHz clock signals.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Phase Interpolator Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u
.param W_xm13=5u L_xm13=0.5u
.param W_xm14=5u L_xm14=0.5u
.param W_xm15=5u L_xm15=0.5u
.param W_xm16=5u L_xm16=0.5u
.param W_xm17=5u L_xm17=0.5u
.param W_xm18=5u L_xm18=0.5u

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
* Biases to keep tail current sources in saturation
VLABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_1 0 0.4
VLABEL_NET_7 LABEL_NET_7 0 1.2

* 1 GHz differential clock inputs
Vclk clk 0 PULSE(0 1.8 0 50p 50p 450p 1n)
Vclkb clkb 0 PULSE(1.8 0 0 50p 50p 450p 1n)

* Connect inputs to clock phases
R0 clk LABEL_NET_0 1
R2 clk LABEL_NET_2 1
R6 clk LABEL_NET_6 1
R4 clkb LABEL_NET_4 1
R5 clkb LABEL_NET_5 1

* DUT
XM1 N0 N0 N3 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N2 N2 N5 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N0 N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N5 LABEL_NET_0 N4 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N4 LABEL_NET_1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N3 LABEL_NET_2 N4 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N1 VDD N6 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 LABEL_NET_3 LABEL_NET_4 N6 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N8 LABEL_NET_5 N6 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N2 N2 N7 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 N2 N2 N8 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XM12 N2 N2 LABEL_NET_3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}
XM13 N7 LABEL_NET_6 N4 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm13} w={W_xm13}
XM14 N6 LABEL_NET_7 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm14} w={W_xm14}
XM15 N0 N0 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm15} w={W_xm15}
XM16 N2 N2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm16} w={W_xm16}
XM17 N2 N2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm17} w={W_xm17}
XM18 N0 N0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm18} w={W_xm18}

.control
tran 10p 5n

* Measure propagation delay from input clock to output N2
meas tran t_delay trig v(clk) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(N2) val=0.9 fall=1

* Measure output voltage swing
meas tran v_max max v(N2)
meas tran v_min min v(N2)
let v_swing = v_max - v_min
print v_swing

* Measure average power consumption
let power = -i(VVDD)*1.8
meas tran avg_power avg power

quit
.endc
